title: Man is to Computer Programmer as Woman is to Homemaker? Debiasing Word Embeddings
reasoning: The paper focuses on gender bias in static word embeddings (word2vec). While it briefly mentions religious bias as an area for potential application and includes some religious word pairs (e.g., nun/priest, monastery/convent) in its analogy sets, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethical systems as a core component of the research.
